description: This file defines classes for handling half-precision floating point support in tensor expressions, including checking for half types and rewriting expressions involving half types.

classes.name: HalfChecker
classes.description: A visitor class that checks for the presence of Half and BFloat16 types in tensor expressions.

classes.name: HalfRewriter
classes.description: A mutator class that rewrites tensor expressions involving Half types, inserting casts and simplifying casts.

methods.name: HalfChecker::hasHalf
methods.description: Returns whether Half type was found.

methods.name: HalfChecker::hasBFloat16
methods.description: Returns whether BFloat16 type was found.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const LoadPtr& v)
methods.description: Rewrites load expressions involving Half types by inserting casts to float.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const StorePtr& v)
methods.description: Rewrites store expressions involving Half types, inserting casts as needed.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const HalfImmPtr& v)
methods.description: Replaces Half immediate values with float casts.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const BFloat16ImmPtr& v)
methods.description: Replaces BFloat16 immediate values with float casts.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const CastPtr& v)
methods.description: Simplifies or modifies cast expressions involving Half types.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const LetPtr& v)
methods.description: Rewrites let bindings involving Half types, replacing variables with float casts.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const VarPtr& v)
methods.description: Replaces variables with their mapped counterparts if present.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutateArithmetic
methods.description: Helper template to mutate arithmetic expressions, converting Half types to float.

methods.name: HalfRewriter::mutate(const AddPtr& v)
methods.description: Mutates addition expressions involving Half types.
